CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(p_session uuid, p_failed_director uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  m public.master_v2_sessions;
  run public.mission_run_state;
  work mission_generic_owner.work_items;
  window_row mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;
  receipt mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
  static_failure boolean;
  budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;
  budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;
  budget_pol mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy;
  budget_spent numeric;budget_http bigint;budget_bound numeric;budget_cap_cost numeric;budget_cap_http integer;budget_ok boolean;

  fixed_release jsonb;current_manual_authority jsonb;
  fix jsonb;
begin
  -- Named, zero-provider recovery. Preserve the terminal work and receipt.
  -- Release only the unconsumed source; the normal service enqueuer will
  -- capture the same latest roles and issue a fresh current-Root contract.
  IF p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
    AND p_failed_director='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid THEN
    m:=mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_regen_scope(p_session,auth.uid());
    PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_CURSOR_MISSING' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
    SELECT * INTO STRICT run FROM public.mission_run_state
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items
      WHERE id=p_failed_director AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT window_row FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
      WHERE id=work.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=work.id
        AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL
      AND window_row.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
      AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
        'status','released','replayed',true);
    END IF;
    IF run.run_phase IS DISTINCT FROM 'in_corso' OR m.closed_at IS NOT NULL
      OR work.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR work.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
      OR work.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM 'd9bcfa25361578bc3213b754c30076336d108c9f3a516360a534416c40686038'
      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM '71dcd5af8c1022ae8d546719f739065462dc3f51715a3e4ac700e8da9b43dc91'
      OR work.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(work.payload)
      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(work.result)
      OR work.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
      OR work.result->>'failure_code' IS DISTINCT FROM 'request_validation_failed'
      OR work.result->'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
      OR work.result->'charged_cost_usd' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
      OR work.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR work.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
      OR work.receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'd1143e1a-f74e-47a1-9cef-44cd5dfda65b'::uuid
      OR work.dispatch_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a1111f12-52c1-4628-b015-a76bfb6ac552'::uuid
      OR work.finalized_at IS NULL OR work.message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL OR window_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM run.current_step_key
      OR window_row.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM run.control_version
      OR window_row.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.definition_sha256
      OR window_row.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.payload_sha256
      OR window_row.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM '0f3feca5bc4e0c839f26cc43b8ddebf8e372ebdbfaab3ec88cb64e5eff436cef'
      OR window_row.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session)
      OR window_row.role_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['cb3e0cb1-b046-4462-84df-7916056fedc6'::uuid,'0df4a6cd-c396-4bf2-ba0a-05184d9a20b5'::uuid]
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(window_row.role_ids) role_id
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
          WHERE lr.message_id=role_id AND lr.valid))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.source_window_id=window_row.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items newer
        WHERE newer.master_session_id=p_session AND newer.created_at>work.created_at)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items active
        WHERE active.master_session_id=p_session AND active.state NOT IN('completed','failed'))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions cs WHERE cs.master_session_id=p_session AND cs.closed_at IS NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_SOURCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts
      WHERE id=work.dispatch_receipt_id FOR SHARE;
    IF receipt.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_session
      OR receipt.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR receipt.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM work.request_key
      OR receipt.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR receipt.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR receipt.upper_bound_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.finalized_at IS NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code LIKE 'c8_count_%')
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.source_id=receipt.id)
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
        WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed'
          AND a.details->>'work_id'=work.id::text
          AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=work.receipt_id::text
          AND a.details->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
          AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=work.result_sha256
          AND a.details->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb
          AND a.details->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb)<>1
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 wc
        WHERE wc.work_id=work.id AND wc.master_session_id=p_session
          AND wc.contract_sha256='2efea76854b67c641e0d5a340afcc55e5e87115129bf449a66858368afc34406'
          AND wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
          AND wc.release_sha256='a446f0113dd39f6ab6b4c9b5a625006bb4d6a1cfd2295488e338f7357e9c0a2c')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_ZERO_PROVIDER_ATTESTATION' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    current_manual_authority:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(p_session,false,true);
    SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb INTO fixed_release
      FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
      JOIN mission_factory_owner.c464_control cc ON cc.singleton
      WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.scope='staff' AND rr.state='enabled'
        AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256
        AND rr.revision_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
        AND rr.staff_guards_verified AND rr.published_assets_verified
        AND cc.complete AND cc.runtime_enabled AND NOT cc.authoring_enabled
        -- Manual Staff admission /3 follows current runtime authority, not
        -- the historical campaign expiry retained in c464_control.
        AND current_manual_authority->>'schema_version'='c1266-execution-authority/1'
        AND current_manual_authority->'runtime_authorized'='true'::jsonb
        AND current_manual_authority->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
        AND current_manual_authority#>>'{admission,schema_version}'='c1266-staff-admission-authority/3'
        AND current_manual_authority#>>'{admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
        AND current_manual_authority#>>'{admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'
        AND current_manual_authority#>>'{admission,location_id}'=m.location_id::text
        AND current_manual_authority->>'release_sha256'=rr.revision_sha256
        AND current_manual_authority->>'binding_sha256'=work.definition_sha256
        AND cc.release_sha256=rr.revision_sha256
        AND cc.review_sha256=rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      FOR SHARE OF rr,cc;
    fix:=fixed_release#>'{config,c1266_request_size_fix}';
    IF fix->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-request-size-fix/1'
      OR fix->>'scene_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_session::text
      OR fix->>'failed_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM work.id::text
      OR fix->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM work.payload_sha256
      OR fix->>'result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM work.result_sha256
      OR fix->>'retry_source_md5' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT md5(p.prosrc) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      OR fix->>'release_source_md5' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT md5(p.prosrc) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(uuid)'::regprocedure)
      OR fix->>'review_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM fixed_release#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      OR (fix->>'review_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(fixed_release->'edge_bundles') eb
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(eb->'files') ef
        WHERE eb->>'name'='mission_generic_ai' AND eb->>'version'='89'
          AND eb->>'ezbr_sha256'=fix->>'edge_bundle_sha256'
          AND ef->>'name'='mission-generic-runtime.mjs' AND ef->>'sha256'=fix->>'runtime_module_sha256')
      OR mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_FIXED_COMPOSITION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
      SET superseded_at=clock_timestamp(),superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
      WHERE id=window_row.id AND superseded_at IS NULL AND consumed_message_id IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_SOURCE_CAS' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)
      VALUES(receipt.id,'staff_preprovider_request_retry',jsonb_build_object(
        'schema_version','c1266-request-size-release/1','master_session_id',p_session,
        'work_id',work.id,'source_window_id',window_row.id,'payload_sha256',work.payload_sha256,
        'result_sha256',work.result_sha256,'role_ids_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(window_row.role_ids)),
        'source_revision',window_row.context->>'source_revision',
        'fixed_release_sha256',(SELECT revision_sha256 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton),
        'fixed_review_sha256',fix->>'review_sha256','fixed_runtime_sha256',fix->>'runtime_module_sha256',
        'fixed_bundle_sha256',fix->>'edge_bundle_sha256',
        'provider_calls',0,'charged_cost_usd',0,'historical_work_preserved',true));
    IF NOT mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_RELEASE_NOT_ATTESTED' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
      'status','released','replayed',false);
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_failed_director AND master_session_id=p_session;
  IF FOUND AND work.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1' THEN
    IF auth.uid() NOT IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid)
      OR auth.uid() IS NULL OR p_session<>'ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
      OR combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed('0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid,array[auth.uid()],false) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_STAFF_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
    PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
    SELECT * INTO STRICT run FROM public.mission_run_state WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_failed_director AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT (work.state='failed' AND work.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1'
 AND work.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW"]'::jsonb
 AND work.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND work.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
 AND work.authorization_id IS NULL AND work.dispatch_id IS NULL AND work.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND work.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
 AND work.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(work.result) AND work.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(work.payload)
 AND work.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=d.id AND a.event_code='generic_count_overflow_terminal'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp ON cp.receipt_id=d.id AND cp.event_code='c8_count_success'
 JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls ct ON ct.id=(a.details->>'count_ticket')::uuid
 WHERE d.id=work.dispatch_receipt_id AND d.master_session_id=work.master_session_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=work.id
 AND d.status='failed' AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND d.charged_cost_usd=0 AND d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL
 AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1264-count-overflow-terminal/1' AND a.details->>'work_id'=work.id::text
 AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=work.receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=work.result_sha256
 AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=work.authority_receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'payload_sha256'=work.payload_sha256
 AND cp.details->>'measurement_id'=a.details->>'measurement_id' AND cp.details->>'state'='success'
 AND cp.details->>'generation_allowed'='false' AND (cp.details->>'input_tokens')::integer>12000
 AND cp.details->>'max_input_tokens'='12000' AND cp.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
 AND ct.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND ct.scope_id=work.master_session_id AND ct.source_id=d.id AND ct.call_no=2
 AND ct.state='unknown_billable' AND ct.charged_usd IS NULL AND ct.reserved_usd=0.0112
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=d.id))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_COUNT_ATTESTATION' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb INTO fixed_release FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
      JOIN mission_factory_owner.c464_control cc ON cc.singleton WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.scope='staff' AND rr.state='enabled'
      AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256 AND cc.complete AND cc.runtime_enabled AND NOT cc.authoring_enabled
      AND cc.expires_at>statement_timestamp() AND cc.release_sha256=rr.revision_sha256
      AND cc.review_sha256=rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      AND rr.staff_guards_verified AND rr.published_assets_verified
      AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=rr.revision_sha256 FOR SHARE OF rr,cc;
    fix:=fixed_release#>'{config,count_overflow_fix}';
    IF fix->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1264-count-overflow-fix/1'
      OR fix->>'runtime_module_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM '2f2f9f992b5d82ffc28888bf7338708aac0166c6e850225953112895a6743eca'
      OR fix->>'retry_source_md5' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT md5(p.prosrc) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      OR fix->>'review_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM fixed_release#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(fixed_release->'edge_bundles') eb CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(eb->'files') ef WHERE ef->>'name'='mission-generic-runtime.mjs' AND ef->>'sha256'='2f2f9f992b5d82ffc28888bf7338708aac0166c6e850225953112895a6743eca' AND eb->>'ezbr_sha256'=fix->>'edge_bundle_sha256')
      OR mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR run.run_phase<>'in_corso' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_FIXED_COMPOSITION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT window_row FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=work.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=work.id AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND window_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry' AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1','status','released','replayed',true);END IF;
    IF window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL OR window_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL OR window_row.step_key<>run.current_step_key
      OR window_row.run_control_version<>run.control_version OR window_row.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session)
      OR work.payload_sha256<>window_row.source_sha256 OR work.definition_sha256<>window_row.definition_sha256
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.source_window_id=window_row.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items newer WHERE newer.master_session_id=p_session AND newer.created_at>work.created_at)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions c WHERE c.master_session_id=p_session AND c.state='in_corso')
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(window_row.role_ids) role_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) latest WHERE latest.message_id=role_id AND latest.valid)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_SOURCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    -- Same cumulative Native C7 ledger, read-only arithmetic for authenticated Staff.
    -- Native reserve/consume keep their service-only C7 enforcement unchanged.
    select * into strict budget_pol from mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy where singleton for share;
    select * into strict budget_a from mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions where master_session_id=p_session for update;
    select * into strict budget_g from mission_generic_owner.provider_policy where singleton for share;
    budget_bound:=(budget_pol.max_input_tokens*budget_pol.input_usd_million+budget_pol.max_output_tokens*budget_pol.output_usd_million)/1000000;
    budget_cap_cost:=least(budget_g.run_budget_usd,budget_a.cost_budget_usd,coalesce(budget_pol.run_budget_usd,budget_g.run_budget_usd));
    budget_cap_http:=2*least(budget_g.max_run_calls,budget_a.call_limit);
    select coalesce(sum(case when d.status in('success','fallback','unknown_billable')
      then coalesce(d.charged_cost_usd,d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0)
      when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then greatest(coalesce(d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0),budget_bound)
      else coalesce(d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0) end + case when ca.details is not null then (ca.details->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then coalesce(budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd,0) else 0 end),0),
      coalesce(sum(case when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then 2 else (case when ca.details is not null then 1 else 0 end)+(case when d.upper_bound_cost_usd is not null or exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da where da.receipt_id=d.id) then 1 else 0 end) end),0)
    into budget_spent,budget_http from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    left join mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d on d.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
    left join mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ca on ca.receipt_id=d.id and ca.event_code='c8_count_started'
    where wi.master_session_id=p_session and (wi.dispatch_receipt_id is not null or wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started'));
    budget_http:=greatest(budget_http,budget_a.calls_authorized);
    budget_ok:=budget_a.enabled and budget_g.enabled and budget_a.c7_budget_enforced
      and budget_a.c7_budget_qualification_sha256 is not null and budget_a.c8_count_qualification_sha256 is not null
      and budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd is not null and budget_bound>=0 and budget_bound<'Infinity'::numeric
      and budget_cap_cost>0 and budget_cap_http>0
      and budget_spent+budget_bound+budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd<=budget_cap_cost and budget_http+2<=budget_cap_http;

    IF budget_ok IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_BUDGET_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows SET superseded_at=clock_timestamp(),superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry' WHERE id=window_row.id AND superseded_at IS NULL AND consumed_message_id IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_WINDOW_CAS' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details) VALUES(work.dispatch_receipt_id,'staff_failed_director_validation_retry',jsonb_build_object('attestation_schema','c1264-count-overflow-release/1','master_session_id',p_session,'work_id',work.id,'source_window_id',window_row.id,'payload_sha256',work.payload_sha256,'role_ids_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(window_row.role_ids)),'fixed_runtime_sha256','2f2f9f992b5d82ffc28888bf7338708aac0166c6e850225953112895a6743eca','fixed_release_sha256',(SELECT revision_sha256 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton),'fixed_review_sha256',fix->>'review_sha256'));
    IF NOT mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_RETRY_RELEASE_NOT_ATTESTED' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1','status','released','replayed',false);
  END IF;
  if p_session is null or p_failed_director is null then
    raise exception 'SAR_INPUT_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  m := mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_regen_scope(p_session, auth.uid());
  perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors
    where master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'SAR_ROLE_CURSOR_MISSING' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  perform public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
  select * into strict run from public.mission_run_state
    where master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if m.closed_at is not null or run.run_phase<>'in_corso' then
    raise exception 'SAR_RUN_NOT_ACTIVE' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  select * into strict work from mission_generic_owner.work_items
    where id=p_failed_director and master_session_id=p_session for update;
  static_failure := work.id='08fd12a0-7da9-4ba5-902a-dc50e1c7c304'::uuid
    and p_session='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
    and work.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
    and work.result->>'provider_status'='completed';
  if static_failure is true then
    select rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb into fixed_release
      from mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
      join mission_factory_owner.c464_control cc on cc.singleton
      where rr.singleton and rr.scope='staff' and rr.state='enabled'
        and rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256
        and rr.staff_guards_verified and rr.published_assets_verified
        and encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=rr.revision_sha256
        and cc.complete and cc.runtime_enabled and not cc.authoring_enabled
        and cc.expires_at>statement_timestamp() and cc.release_sha256=rr.revision_sha256
        and rr.independent_review_ref=rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_ref}'
        and cc.review_sha256=rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      for share of rr,cc;
    fix:=fixed_release#>'{config,director_window_progression_fix}';
    if fixed_release#>>'{contract,version}' is distinct from 'C1259-STATIC-PROGRESS-WINDOW1'
      or fix->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'c1259-director-window-progression-fix/1'
      or fix->>'runtime_module_sha256' is distinct from '8a93f69e150a6edc67af83d833f422428b444d63c6e90b2ea8cfbb9b10496ecb'
      or fix->>'review_ref' is distinct from fixed_release#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_ref}'
      or fix->>'review_sha256' is distinct from fixed_release#>>'{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}'
      or fix->>'retry_source_md5' is distinct from (select md5(p.prosrc) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p where p.oid='public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(fixed_release->'edge_bundles') eb
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(eb->'files') ef
        where ef->>'name'='mission-generic-runtime.mjs' and ef->>'sha256'='8a93f69e150a6edc67af83d833f422428b444d63c6e90b2ea8cfbb9b10496ecb'
          and eb->>'ezbr_sha256'=fix->>'edge_bundle_sha256')
      or mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session) is distinct from true
      or mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) is distinct from true
      or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session)
      or not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb where rb.master_session_id=p_session
        and rb.snapshot_sha256='49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567'
        and rb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb.snapshot)) then
      raise exception 'SAR_STATIC_FIXED_RUNTIME_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';
    end if;
  end if;
  if work.kind<>'director' or work.state<>'failed'
    or (work.result->'failure_codes' =
      '["MISSION_UNIFIED_DIRECTOR_ACTOR_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
      or (work.result->>'ok'='true'
        and work.result#>>'{decision,action_kind}'='context'
        and work.result#>'{decision,opportunity_id}'='null'::jsonb
        and jsonb_typeof(work.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')='array'
        and jsonb_array_length(work.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')>0
        and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(work.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}') ni
          where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense')
        and exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit failure_audit
          where failure_audit.receipt_id=work.dispatch_receipt_id
            and failure_audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
            and failure_audit.details->>'work_id'=work.id::text
            and failure_audit.details->>'state'='failed'
            and failure_audit.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='22023'
            and failure_audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false')) or static_failure) is not true then
    return jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
      'status','not_applicable');
  end if;
  select * into strict window_row from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
    where id=work.authority_receipt_id and work_id=work.id
      and master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if window_row.superseded_at is not null
    and window_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
    and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
      'status','released','replayed',true);
  end if;
  if window_row.superseded_at is not null or window_row.consumed_message_id is not null
    or window_row.step_key<>run.current_step_key
    or window_row.run_control_version<>run.control_version
    or window_row.context->>'source_revision' is distinct from
      mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session)
    or work.payload_sha256<>window_row.source_sha256
    or work.definition_sha256<>window_row.definition_sha256
    or work.finalized_at is null
    or work.result->>'provider_calls'<>'1'
    or work.result->>'outcome_uncertain'<>'false'
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b
      where b.source_window_id=window_row.id)
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items newer
      where newer.master_session_id=p_session and newer.created_at>work.created_at)
    or exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions combat
      where combat.master_session_id=p_session and combat.state='in_corso')
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(window_row.role_ids) role_id
      where not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) latest
        where latest.message_id=role_id and latest.valid)) then
    raise exception 'SAR_SOURCE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001';
  end if;
  select * into strict receipt from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts
    where id=work.dispatch_receipt_id for share;
  if receipt.authority_receipt_id<>work.id
    or receipt.master_session_id<>p_session
    or receipt.status not in ('success','fallback')
    or receipt.dispatch_count<>1 or receipt.finalized_at is null
    or receipt.charged_cost_usd is null then
    raise exception 'SAR_RECEIPT_UNCERTAIN' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  if static_failure is true then
    -- Same cumulative Native C7 ledger, read-only arithmetic for authenticated Staff.
    -- Native reserve/consume keep their service-only C7 enforcement unchanged.
    select * into strict budget_pol from mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy where singleton for share;
    select * into strict budget_a from mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions where master_session_id=p_session for update;
    select * into strict budget_g from mission_generic_owner.provider_policy where singleton for share;
    budget_bound:=(budget_pol.max_input_tokens*budget_pol.input_usd_million+budget_pol.max_output_tokens*budget_pol.output_usd_million)/1000000;
    budget_cap_cost:=least(budget_g.run_budget_usd,budget_a.cost_budget_usd,coalesce(budget_pol.run_budget_usd,budget_g.run_budget_usd));
    budget_cap_http:=2*least(budget_g.max_run_calls,budget_a.call_limit);
    select coalesce(sum(case when d.status in('success','fallback','unknown_billable')
      then coalesce(d.charged_cost_usd,d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0)
      when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then greatest(coalesce(d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0),budget_bound)
      else coalesce(d.upper_bound_cost_usd,0) end + case when ca.details is not null then (ca.details->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then coalesce(budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd,0) else 0 end),0),
      coalesce(sum(case when wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started') then 2 else (case when ca.details is not null then 1 else 0 end)+(case when d.upper_bound_cost_usd is not null or exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da where da.receipt_id=d.id) then 1 else 0 end) end),0)
    into budget_spent,budget_http from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    left join mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d on d.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
    left join mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ca on ca.receipt_id=d.id and ca.event_code='c8_count_started'
    where wi.master_session_id=p_session and (wi.dispatch_receipt_id is not null or wi.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started'));
    budget_http:=greatest(budget_http,budget_a.calls_authorized);
    budget_ok:=budget_a.enabled and budget_g.enabled and budget_a.c7_budget_enforced
      and budget_a.c7_budget_qualification_sha256 is not null and budget_a.c8_count_qualification_sha256 is not null
      and budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd is not null and budget_bound>=0 and budget_bound<'Infinity'::numeric
      and budget_cap_cost>0 and budget_cap_http>0
      and budget_spent+budget_bound+budget_a.c8_count_upper_cost_usd<=budget_cap_cost and budget_http+2<=budget_cap_http;
    if not exists(select 1 from staff_ai_quota_private.calls c
      where c.producer='mission_generic_ai' and c.source_id=receipt.id
        and c.scope_id=p_session and c.call_no=1 and c.state='settled'
        and c.charged_usd=receipt.charged_cost_usd)
      or budget_ok is distinct from true then
      raise exception 'SAR_STATIC_SETTLEMENT_OR_BUDGET_CLOSED' using errcode='55000';
    end if;
  end if;
  update mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
    set superseded_at=clock_timestamp(),
      superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
    where id=window_row.id and superseded_at is null
      and consumed_message_id is null;
  if not found then raise exception 'SAR_WINDOW_CAS' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  insert into mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)
    values(receipt.id,'staff_failed_director_validation_retry',
      jsonb_build_object('master_session_id',p_session,'work_id',work.id,
        'source_window_id',window_row.id,'attestation_schema',case when static_failure is true then 'c1263-static-release-attestation/1' else null end,'origin_release_sha256',case when static_failure is true then '61eb04f05f102a72ca7c55a0fd90ed98c2e17144b295678c73af55911be32821' else null end,'window_source_sha256',case when static_failure is true then window_row.source_sha256 else null end,'role_ids_sha256',case when static_failure is true then public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(window_row.role_ids)) else null end,'fixed_retry_source_md5',case when static_failure is true then (select md5(p.prosrc) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p where p.oid='public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure) else null end,'fixed_bundle_sha256',case when static_failure is true then fix->>'edge_bundle_sha256' else null end,'fixed_release_sha256',case when static_failure is true then (select revision_sha256 from mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness where singleton) else null end,
        'runtime_module_sha256',case when static_failure is true then fix->>'runtime_module_sha256' else null end,'fixed_review_sha256',case when static_failure is true then fix->>'review_sha256' else null end,'failure_code',
        case when static_failure is true then 'MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED'
        when work.result->'failure_codes' is null then
          'MNE_DIRECTOR_ENTRY_INVALID' else
          'MISSION_UNIFIED_DIRECTOR_ACTOR_REJECTED' end));
  if not mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) then
    raise exception 'SAR_RELEASE_NOT_ATTESTED' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
    'status','released','replayed',false);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(p_source uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE source_row mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows%ROWTYPE;
        stale_work uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_source IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO source_row FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
    WHERE id=p_source;
  IF NOT FOUND OR source_row.superseded_at IS NULL
    OR source_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
    OR source_row.superseded_reason IS NULL
    OR source_row.superseded_reason NOT IN
      ('new_role_before_provider','role_revision_changed','staff_failed_director_validation_retry','staff_preprovider_request_retry')
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    WHERE (wi.id=source_row.work_id OR wi.id IN (
      SELECT batch.writer_work_id FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
      WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL))
    AND wi.state NOT IN ('completed','failed')
  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry' THEN
    RETURN source_row.id='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid
      AND source_row.work_id=source_row.id
      AND source_row.master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
      AND source_row.role_ids=ARRAY['cb3e0cb1-b046-4462-84df-7916056fedc6'::uuid,'0df4a6cd-c396-4bf2-ba0a-05184d9a20b5'::uuid]
      AND source_row.source_sha256='d9bcfa25361578bc3213b754c30076336d108c9f3a516360a534416c40686038'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
        JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
        JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 wc ON wc.work_id=wi.id
        WHERE wi.id=source_row.work_id AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
          AND wi.authority_receipt_id=source_row.id AND wi.kind='director' AND wi.state='failed'
          AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND wi.message_id IS NULL
          AND wi.authorization_id IS NULL AND wi.dispatch_id IS NULL
          AND wi.payload_sha256=source_row.source_sha256
          AND wi.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wi.payload)
          AND wi.result_sha256='71dcd5af8c1022ae8d546719f739065462dc3f51715a3e4ac700e8da9b43dc91'
          AND wi.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wi.result)
          AND wi.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
          AND wi.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
          AND wi.result->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb AND wi.result->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb
          AND receipt.id='a1111f12-52c1-4628-b015-a76bfb6ac552'::uuid
          AND receipt.master_session_id=wi.master_session_id AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
          AND receipt.request_key=wi.request_key AND receipt.status='failed'
          AND receipt.dispatch_count=0 AND receipt.charged_cost_usd=0 AND receipt.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
          AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
          AND wc.master_session_id=wi.master_session_id
          AND wc.contract_sha256='2efea76854b67c641e0d5a340afcc55e5e87115129bf449a66858368afc34406'
          AND wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
          AND wc.release_sha256='a446f0113dd39f6ab6b4c9b5a625006bb4d6a1cfd2295488e338f7357e9c0a2c'
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.source_window_id=source_row.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code LIKE 'c8_count_%')
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.source_id=receipt.id)
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
            WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed'
              AND a.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=wi.receipt_id::text
              AND a.details->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
              AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=wi.result_sha256
              AND a.details->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb AND a.details->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb)=1
          AND (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
            WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
              AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-request-size-release/1'
              AND a.details->>'master_session_id'=wi.master_session_id::text
              AND a.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text
              AND a.details->>'payload_sha256'=wi.payload_sha256 AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=wi.result_sha256
              AND a.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(source_row.role_ids))
              AND a.details->>'source_revision'='0f3feca5bc4e0c839f26cc43b8ddebf8e372ebdbfaab3ec88cb64e5eff436cef'
              AND a.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
              AND a.details->>'fixed_review_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
              AND a.details->>'fixed_runtime_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
              AND a.details->>'fixed_bundle_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
              AND a.details->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb AND a.details->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb
              AND a.details->'historical_work_preserved'='true'::jsonb)=1);
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
    AND source_row.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w WHERE w.id=source_row.work_id AND w.authority_receipt_id=source_row.id AND (w.state='failed' AND w.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1'
 AND w.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW"]'::jsonb
 AND w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND w.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
 AND w.authorization_id IS NULL AND w.dispatch_id IS NULL AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
 AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 AND w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=d.id AND a.event_code='generic_count_overflow_terminal'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp ON cp.receipt_id=d.id AND cp.event_code='c8_count_success'
 JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls ct ON ct.id=(a.details->>'count_ticket')::uuid
 WHERE d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND d.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=w.id
 AND d.status='failed' AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND d.charged_cost_usd=0 AND d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL
 AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1264-count-overflow-terminal/1' AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
 AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256
 AND cp.details->>'measurement_id'=a.details->>'measurement_id' AND cp.details->>'state'='success'
 AND cp.details->>'generation_allowed'='false' AND (cp.details->>'input_tokens')::integer>12000
 AND cp.details->>'max_input_tokens'='12000' AND cp.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
 AND ct.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND ct.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND ct.source_id=d.id AND ct.call_no=2
 AND ct.state='unknown_billable' AND ct.charged_usd IS NULL AND ct.reserved_usd=0.0112
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=d.id)))
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ra WHERE ra.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
        AND ra.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
        AND ra.details->>'attestation_schema'='c1264-count-overflow-release/1'
        AND ra.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND ra.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text
        AND ra.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND ra.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(source_row.role_ids))
        AND ra.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ra.details->>'fixed_review_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND ra.details->>'fixed_runtime_sha256'='2f2f9f992b5d82ffc28888bf7338708aac0166c6e850225953112895a6743eca')) THEN RETURN true;END IF;
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry' THEN
    RETURN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
        ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
      WHERE wi.id=source_row.work_id AND wi.id=source_row.id
        AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
        AND wi.kind='director' AND wi.state='failed'
        AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        AND wi.result->>'provider_calls'='1'
        AND wi.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
        AND (wi.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_UNIFIED_DIRECTOR_ACTOR_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
          OR (wi.id='08fd12a0-7da9-4ba5-902a-dc50e1c7c304'::uuid
            AND wi.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
            AND source_row.definition_sha256='49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567'
            AND wi.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
            AND wi.result->>'provider_status'='completed'
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls c
              WHERE c.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND c.source_id=receipt.id AND c.scope_id=wi.master_session_id
                AND c.call_no=1 AND c.state='settled' AND c.charged_usd=receipt.charged_cost_usd)
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit recovery_audit
              WHERE recovery_audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
                AND recovery_audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'master_session_id'=wi.master_session_id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'attestation_schema'='c1263-static-release-attestation/1'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'origin_release_sha256'='61eb04f05f102a72ca7c55a0fd90ed98c2e17144b295678c73af55911be32821'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'window_source_sha256'=source_row.source_sha256
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(source_row.role_ids))
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'failure_code'='MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'runtime_module_sha256'='8a93f69e150a6edc67af83d833f422428b444d63c6e90b2ea8cfbb9b10496ecb'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_review_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_bundle_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_retry_source_md5'~'^[0-9a-f]{32}$'))

          OR (wi.result->>'ok'='true'
            AND wi.result#>>'{decision,action_kind}'='context'
            AND wi.result#>'{decision,opportunity_id}'='null'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')='array'
            AND jsonb_array_length(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')>0
            AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}') ni
              where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense')
            AND EXISTS(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit failure_audit
              where failure_audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
                and failure_audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
                and failure_audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
                and failure_audit.details->>'state'='failed'
                and failure_audit.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='22023'
                and failure_audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false')))
        AND wi.payload_sha256=source_row.source_sha256
        AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
        AND receipt.master_session_id=wi.master_session_id
        AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
        AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
          WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
            AND audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
            AND audit.details->>'master_session_id'=source_row.master_session_id::text
            AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
            AND audit.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text)
    );
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='new_role_before_provider' THEN
    RETURN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
      LEFT JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
        ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
      WHERE (wi.id=source_row.work_id OR wi.id IN (
        SELECT batch.writer_work_id FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
        WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL))
        AND wi.state='failed'
        AND (wi.finalized_at IS NULL OR
          (receipt.id IS NOT NULL AND
            (receipt.status<>'failed' OR receipt.dispatch_count<>0
              OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0)))
    );
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT batch.writer_work_id
      FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
      WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY batch.created_at DESC,batch.id DESC LIMIT 1),source_row.work_id)
    INTO stale_work;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
      ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
    WHERE wi.id=stale_work AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND wi.state='failed' AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
      AND receipt.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
      AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
        WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id AND audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
          AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
          AND audit.details->>'stale'='true'
          AND audit.details->>'state'='failed'
          AND audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
          AND audit.details->>'cost_basis'='exact')
  );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(p_source uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE source_row mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows%ROWTYPE;
        stale_work uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_source IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO source_row FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
    WHERE id=p_source;
  IF NOT FOUND OR source_row.superseded_at IS NULL
    OR source_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
    OR source_row.superseded_reason IS NULL
    OR source_row.superseded_reason NOT IN
      ('new_role_before_provider','role_revision_changed','staff_failed_director_validation_retry')
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    WHERE (wi.id=source_row.work_id OR wi.id IN (
      SELECT batch.writer_work_id FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
      WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL))
    AND wi.state NOT IN ('completed','failed')
  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
    AND source_row.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w WHERE w.id=source_row.work_id AND w.authority_receipt_id=source_row.id AND (w.state='failed' AND w.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1'
 AND w.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW"]'::jsonb
 AND w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND w.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
 AND w.authorization_id IS NULL AND w.dispatch_id IS NULL AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
 AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 AND w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=d.id AND a.event_code='generic_count_overflow_terminal'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp ON cp.receipt_id=d.id AND cp.event_code='c8_count_success'
 JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls ct ON ct.id=(a.details->>'count_ticket')::uuid
 WHERE d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND d.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=w.id
 AND d.status='failed' AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND d.charged_cost_usd=0 AND d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL
 AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1264-count-overflow-terminal/1' AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
 AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256
 AND cp.details->>'measurement_id'=a.details->>'measurement_id' AND cp.details->>'state'='success'
 AND cp.details->>'generation_allowed'='false' AND (cp.details->>'input_tokens')::integer>12000
 AND cp.details->>'max_input_tokens'='12000' AND cp.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
 AND ct.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND ct.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND ct.source_id=d.id AND ct.call_no=2
 AND ct.state='unknown_billable' AND ct.charged_usd IS NULL AND ct.reserved_usd=0.0112
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=d.id)))
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ra WHERE ra.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
        AND ra.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
        AND ra.details->>'attestation_schema'='c1264-count-overflow-release/1'
        AND ra.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND ra.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text
        AND ra.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND ra.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(source_row.role_ids))
        AND ra.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ra.details->>'fixed_review_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND ra.details->>'fixed_runtime_sha256'='2f2f9f992b5d82ffc28888bf7338708aac0166c6e850225953112895a6743eca')) THEN RETURN true;END IF;
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry' THEN
    RETURN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
        ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
      WHERE wi.id=source_row.work_id AND wi.id=source_row.id
        AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
        AND wi.kind='director' AND wi.state='failed'
        AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        AND wi.result->>'provider_calls'='1'
        AND wi.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
        AND (wi.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_UNIFIED_DIRECTOR_ACTOR_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
          OR (wi.id='08fd12a0-7da9-4ba5-902a-dc50e1c7c304'::uuid
            AND wi.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
            AND source_row.definition_sha256='49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567'
            AND wi.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED"]'::jsonb
            AND wi.result->>'provider_status'='completed'
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls c
              WHERE c.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND c.source_id=receipt.id AND c.scope_id=wi.master_session_id
                AND c.call_no=1 AND c.state='settled' AND c.charged_usd=receipt.charged_cost_usd)
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit recovery_audit
              WHERE recovery_audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
                AND recovery_audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'master_session_id'=wi.master_session_id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'attestation_schema'='c1263-static-release-attestation/1'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'origin_release_sha256'='61eb04f05f102a72ca7c55a0fd90ed98c2e17144b295678c73af55911be32821'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'window_source_sha256'=source_row.source_sha256
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(source_row.role_ids))
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'failure_code'='MISSION_DIRECTOR_STATIC_PROGRESS_REJECTED'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'runtime_module_sha256'='8a93f69e150a6edc67af83d833f422428b444d63c6e90b2ea8cfbb9b10496ecb'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_review_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_bundle_sha256'~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
                AND recovery_audit.details->>'fixed_retry_source_md5'~'^[0-9a-f]{32}$'))

          OR (wi.result->>'ok'='true'
            AND wi.result#>>'{decision,action_kind}'='context'
            AND wi.result#>'{decision,opportunity_id}'='null'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')='array'
            AND jsonb_array_length(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}')>0
            AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}') ni
              where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense')
            AND EXISTS(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit failure_audit
              where failure_audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
                and failure_audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
                and failure_audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
                and failure_audit.details->>'state'='failed'
                and failure_audit.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='22023'
                and failure_audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false')))
        AND wi.payload_sha256=source_row.source_sha256
        AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
        AND receipt.master_session_id=wi.master_session_id
        AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
        AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
          WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
            AND audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
            AND audit.details->>'master_session_id'=source_row.master_session_id::text
            AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
            AND audit.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text)
    );
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='new_role_before_provider' THEN
    RETURN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
      LEFT JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
        ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
      WHERE (wi.id=source_row.work_id OR wi.id IN (
        SELECT batch.writer_work_id FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
        WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL))
        AND wi.state='failed'
        AND (wi.finalized_at IS NULL OR
          (receipt.id IS NOT NULL AND
            (receipt.status<>'failed' OR receipt.dispatch_count<>0
              OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0)))
    );
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT batch.writer_work_id
      FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
      WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY batch.created_at DESC,batch.id DESC LIMIT 1),source_row.work_id)
    INTO stale_work;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
      ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
    WHERE wi.id=stale_work AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND wi.state='failed' AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
      AND receipt.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
      AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
        WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id AND audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
          AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
          AND audit.details->>'stale'='true'
          AND audit.details->>'state'='failed'
          AND audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
          AND audit.details->>'cost_basis'='exact')
  );
END;
$function$

-- Named, zero-provider recovery. Preserve the terminal work and receipt.
  -- Release only the unconsumed source; the normal service enqueuer will
  -- capture the same latest roles and issue a fresh current-Root contract.
  IF p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
    AND p_failed_director='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid THEN
    m:=mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_regen_scope(p_session,auth.uid());
    PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_CURSOR_MISSING' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
    SELECT * INTO STRICT run FROM public.mission_run_state
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items
      WHERE id=p_failed_director AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT window_row FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
      WHERE id=work.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=work.id
        AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL
      AND window_row.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
      AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-staff-director-retry/1',
        'status','released','replayed',true);
    END IF;
    IF run.run_phase IS DISTINCT FROM 'in_corso' OR m.closed_at IS NOT NULL
      OR work.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR work.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
      OR work.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM 'd9bcfa25361578bc3213b754c30076336d108c9f3a516360a534416c40686038'
      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM '71dcd5af8c1022ae8d546719f739065462dc3f51715a3e4ac700e8da9b43dc91'
      OR work.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(work.payload)
      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(work.result)
      OR work.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
      OR work.result->>'failure_code' IS DISTINCT FROM 'request_validation_failed'
      OR work.result->'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
      OR work.result->'charged_cost_usd' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'::jsonb
      OR work.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR work.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
      OR work.receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'd1143e1a-f74e-47a1-9cef-44cd5dfda65b'::uuid
      OR work.dispatch_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'a1111f12-52c1-4628-b015-a76bfb6ac552'::uuid
      OR work.finalized_at IS NULL OR work.message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL OR window_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM run.current_step_key
      OR window_row.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM run.control_version
      OR window_row.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.definition_sha256
      OR window_row.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.payload_sha256
      OR window_row.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM '0f3feca5bc4e0c839f26cc43b8ddebf8e372ebdbfaab3ec88cb64e5eff436cef'
      OR window_row.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session)
      OR window_row.role_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['cb3e0cb1-b046-4462-84df-7916056fedc6'::uuid,'0df4a6cd-c396-4bf2-ba0a-05184d9a20b5'::uuid]
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(window_row.role_ids) role_id
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
          WHERE lr.message_id=role_id AND lr.valid))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.source_window_id=window_row.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items newer
        WHERE newer.master_session_id=p_session AND newer.created_at>work.created_at)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items active
        WHERE active.master_session_id=p_session AND active.state NOT IN('completed','failed'))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions cs WHERE cs.master_session_id=p_session AND cs.closed_at IS NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REQUEST_RETRY_SOURCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts
      WHERE id=work.dispatch_receipt_id FOR SHARE;
    IF receipt.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_session
      OR receipt.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR receipt.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM work.request_key
      OR receipt.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR receipt.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR receipt.upper_bound_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.finalized_at IS NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code LIKE 'c8_count_%')
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.source_id=receipt.id)
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
        WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed'
          AND a.details->>'work_id'=work.id::text
          AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=work.receipt_id::text
          AND a.details->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'

sources.recovery/RECOVERY_CONSERVATIVA.md:
Candidata isolata, non installata e non qualificata da review indipendente.

La recovery opera solo sul failed director d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e della scena 44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac. Richiede hash esatti di payload/result/contract, receipt fallita a zero chiamate/costo, audit preprovider, nessun Count/provider auth/attempt/quota, role latest correnti immutate, nessun lavoro successivo/combat aperto. La sola scrittura runtime chiude logicamente la source con motivo esplicito e aggiunge audit. Nessun update del work/receipt/contract/result, nessuna cancellazione, reset, variazione contatori o Fati.

Il tasto UI normale riceve released e updateRoom ripassa da progress_step: il failed storico non blocca perché role_source_released_v4 lo attesta. unified_enqueue_director crea il successor dalla stessa source_revision/latest role, poi la normale claim emette contratto sotto Root corrente. Quindi il vecchio contratto Root a446 rimane sigillato e non serve counted_resume_evidence. Verificare in preflight/postflight che il nuovo source contenga esattamente le due role attese; se un nuovo invio concorrente cambia le role, fermare il dispatch. La release da sola non concede HTTP/provider; rimangono i normali gate di budget della claim.

Configurazione Root richiesta: config.c1266_request_size_fix con schema_version=c1266-request-size-fix/1, scene_id,failed_work_id,payload_sha256,result_sha256,runtime_module_sha256,edge_bundle_sha256,retry_source_md5,release_source_md5,review_sha256. Review uguale a config.staff_finite_ia_budget.composed_review_sha256; Edge89 nel tuple. Pin source MD5 ricavati DOPO freeze, senza cambiare soltanto vecchi pin.

Recovery installazione conservativa: non attivare il recupero runtime prima della composizione verificata. Un errore nella transazione SQL annulla integralmente corpi e metadati DB; la Edge osservata va riconciliata con un delta minimo integrato e sottoposto a review, senza applicare vecchie Root o ripristinare soltanto corpi baseline. Un eventuale ripristino richiede la stessa composizione coerente DB/Edge/Root/G2/admission e una review pertinente. Non modificare flag di accesso o budget. Dopo la release source, non riaprire source né receipt: mantenere audit e proseguire tramite il successor già emesso. Nessun rollback dei dati o dello storico. ACL/firme invariate; CREATE OR REPLACE conserva i grant. role_source_released resta helper owner-only, public retry conserva authenticated. Nessuna modifica admin richiesta: nessun dato editoriale o categoria/campo nuovo.

s+=guard("jsonb_array_length(newpre#>'{db_core,c1266_functions}')=112 AND jsonb_array_length(newpre#>'{db_core,all_function_headers}')=146",'REQUEST_INSTALL_COUNTS')
s+=" root_text:=newpre::text;\n"+guard('octet_length(root_text)<=262144','REQUEST_INSTALL_ROOT_SIZE')+" root_sha:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(root_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');\n"
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness SET canonical_preimage=root_text,revision_sha256=root_sha,observed_revision_sha256=root_sha,client_build=\'mission-factory-admin/2:\'||root_sha,independent_review_ref='+q(rr['path'])+',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton AND revision_sha256='+q(root)+';\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','REQUEST_INSTALL_ROOT_CAS')
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.c464_control SET release_sha256=root_sha,review_sha256='+q(rr['sha256'])+' WHERE singleton;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','REQUEST_INSTALL_G2_CAS')
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions SET release_sha256=root_sha WHERE actor_user IN('+','.join(q(a['actor_user']) for a in b['admissions'])+');\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=2','REQUEST_INSTALL_ADMISSIONS_CAS')
for path,expr in [('{root,canonical_preimage}','to_jsonb(root_text)'),('{root,revision_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)'),('{root,observed_revision_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)'),('{root,client_build}',"to_jsonb('mission-factory-admin/2:'||root_sha)"),('{root,independent_review_ref}','to_jsonb('+q(rr['path'])+'::text)'),('{g2,release_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)'),('{g2,review_sha256}','to_jsonb('+q(rr['sha256'])+'::text)'),('{headers}',"(SELECT jsonb_agg(h ORDER BY h->>'signature') FROM jsonb_array_elements(newpre#>'{db_core,all_function_headers}') h)")]:s+=' expected:=jsonb_set(expected,'+q(path)+','+expr+');\n'
for i in range(len(b['admissions'])):s+=' expected:=jsonb_set(expected,'+q('{admissions,'+str(i)+',release_sha256}')+',to_jsonb(root_sha));\n'
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(query)+' INTO actual;\n'+guard("((actual-'captured_at') #- '{root,updated_at}')=(expected #- '{root,updated_at}')",'REQUEST_INSTALL_ONLY_DECLARED_DIFF')
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(extraq)+' INTO after_extra;\n'+guard('after_extra=before_extra','REQUEST_INSTALL_KEEP_SOURCE_FATI')+guard(inflight,'REQUEST_INSTALL_INFLIGHT_AFTER')
s+="END $request_install$;\nNOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';\nCOMMIT;\n";(P/'INSTALL.sql').write_text(s);save('BOUND_MANIFEST.json',{'recipe':ref('RECIPE.json'),'builder':ref('BUILD_INTEGRATED.py'),'installer':ref('INSTALL.sql'),'review':rr,'observed_edge':ref('EDGE_AFTER.json'),'root_tuple':'room RPC volatility header + Root/header/G2/admission metadata; identical prosrc and unchanged Edge89/UI/LAND; aggregate6','runtime_recovery_invoked':False})
print(canon({'installer':ref('INSTALL.sql'),'status':'BOUND_AWAITING_MATERIAL_REVIEW'}))

# C1266 — richiesta Regia compatta, candidata congelata

Baseline Edge88 SHA256 125caa991b04b5a6638fa01f7640bf44bfb738e0bd0aa5add2a8dd30e4d265b6. Candidata SHA256 de445409b852a4e31cf4173123411e271ee80c24c1c4f1e629012b3dfbcc7e2d.

Scope temporaneo isolato; nessun repo/DB/deploy/provider/gameplay. La prima ipotesi persona_overrides e stata SCARTATA: nel caso reale i Book erano gia identici e deduplicati. Il limite autorevole e 65536 byte (provider-input/5), non il ramo teorico98304.

Delta finale:
- Condivisione frammenti JSON Schema identici tramite $defs, comprese definizioni equivalenti dopo espansione DAG. Grammatica espansa identica; validatori e limiti conservati. Numeric gia esclude public_quest.
- Solo Staff numeric peer2: proiezione provider con riferimenti $text_ref per testi esattamente duplicati, escludendo fonti/role/corpi sorgenti/catalogo. Risoluzione reversibile prova contesto narrativo e opportunita identici.
- Roster provider proiettato in slot pN, participation/status e indice fonte integrale; references pubblici proiettati in indici catalogo. Corpi role completi immutati, hash/id/kind fonti mantenuti, dati fase e conoscenze integralmente ricostruibili.
- body_ref mantiene path; id/kind/hash sono sul medesimo catalogsource. Rimosse copie di hash envelope dal solo catalogo trasmesso, conservati nel work/server.
- Ogni quote mantiene indice/startUTF16/endUTF16, nessuna opzione/intervallo rimosso. ROLE e FATO conservano hint letterale prefisso4+suffix4 (quote brevi integrali). Sul caso reale tutti gli hint sono distinti entro ciascuna fonte:23+21+35 quote, zero collisioni. Solo setting omette hint. Corpo completo rimane disponibile al path; nessun calcolo offset richiesto. Rischio residuo: hint piu brevi da osservare nel turno reale.
- Istruzioni Staff numeric condensate, grammatica numeric wire invariata e guardie server immutate. Serve review semantica delle istruzioni concise: non si afferma equivalenza solo per conteggio parole.

Misura STATICA di serializzazione della sorgente reale immutabile, non QA funzionale o certificazione autorita: baseline79737byte -> candidata64557/65536, margine979. Componenti system5594, user25678, schema31275. Tutte le verifiche di preservazione nel report sono true: contesto, opportunita, base progresso, role integrali, binding roster/pubblico, indici/intervalli/identita e opzioni piano/evidenze. Schema espanso identico. Payload canonico immutato. Corpo richiesta diverso per proiezione e istruzioni (previsto).

Il margine979byte (~1KB) vale SOLO per il turno reale misurato e NON garantisce role future di qualunque lunghezza: guardia byte resta failclosed, nessun aumento limite/budget. Writer e percorso Legacy non modificati. Sharing schema e solo proiezione numeric equivalente.

File di misura: measure.mjs e bundle/measure-*.mjs sono STRUMENTAZIONE PRIVATA, non distribuire. Espongono setup cache puro da scope reale e intercettano esclusivamente guardia overflow per misurarla; il sorgente candidato distribuito mantiene throw originale. BASELINE_USER_PRIVATE.json contiene dati privati, non pubblicare ne riportare testi role.
