CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH released AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
    'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request,
   sw.context->>'source_revision' AS source_revision,
   jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision',
    'reason',sw.superseded_reason,'audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details)) AS release
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='failed' AND dr.dispatch_count=0
   AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.charged_cost_usd=0 AND dr.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=dr.id
   AND a.event_code='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-request-size-release/1'
   AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=sw.id::text
  WHERE p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
   AND w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid
   AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.message_id IS NULL
   AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
   AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
   AND sw.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id)
 ),
 candidates AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.*,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.state='completed' AND w.kind IN('director','narration')
   AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   AND w.result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
  ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id LIMIT 128
 ), qualified AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.* FROM candidates w
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='success' AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.event_kind='mission_generic_event' AND dr.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
   AND dr.request_fingerprint=mission_internal.fingerprint(w.request)
   AND dr.envelope_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope) AND dr.authority_sha256=dr.envelope_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND dr.envelope->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'event_id'=w.event_id::text AND dr.envelope->>'authority_receipt_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND dr.envelope->>'definition_sha256'=w.definition_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->'revision'=to_jsonb(w.revision)
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id)->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
   AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
    WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1'
     AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(a.details,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
     AND a.details->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-async-owner/1'
     AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.request)
     AND a.details->>'envelope_sha256'=dr.envelope_sha256 AND a.details->'provider_timeout_ms'='240000'::jsonb)
 ), published AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS writer_work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,w.message_id
  FROM qualified w JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=w.message_id
   AND msg.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND msg.body=w.result->>'text'
  WHERE w.kind='narration' AND (
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=ub.source_window_id
     AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id=w.message_id
    WHERE ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.writer_work_id=w.id
     AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL AND ub.message_id=w.message_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
    JOIN public.mission_run_publications pub ON pub.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id AND pub.event_id=bs.event_id
    JOIN public.mission_run_outbox ob ON ob.publication_id=pub.id AND ob.master_session_id=p_session AND ob.event_id=bs.event_id
     AND ob.state='published' AND ob.published_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication
  FROM qualified w JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=w.id WHERE w.kind='narration'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
 ), settled AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM settled_raw s WHERE 1=(SELECT count(DISTINCT check_s.publication)
   FROM settled_raw check_s WHERE check_s.work_id=s.work_id AND check_s.request=s.request)
 ), items AS(
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',s.request),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication) AS item
  FROM settled s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication)
  FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
   ON pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (
    (pr.request_key=t.request_key AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256)
    OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM released rel
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_pr ON original_pr.request_key=t.request_key
      AND original_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND original_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_pr.result)
      AND original_pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
      AND original_pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
      AND original_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
     WHERE rel.source_revision=t.source_revision
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(rel.work_id,
       'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)))
   AND pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  JOIN settled s ON s.request=pr.result->'dispatch'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=s.work_id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'=t.source_revision AND sw.consumed_message_id=(s.publication->>'message_id')::uuid
  WHERE t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=t.staff_user_id AND p.role IN('admin','master'))

  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',rel.request),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t ON t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision=rel.source_revision
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.*,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.state='completed' AND w.kind IN('director','narration')
   AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   AND w.result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
  ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id LIMIT 128
 ), qualified AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.* FROM candidates w
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='success' AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.event_kind='mission_generic_event' AND dr.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
   AND dr.request_fingerprint=mission_internal.fingerprint(w.request)
   AND dr.envelope_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope) AND dr.authority_sha256=dr.envelope_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND dr.envelope->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'event_id'=w.event_id::text AND dr.envelope->>'authority_receipt_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND dr.envelope->>'definition_sha256'=w.definition_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->'revision'=to_jsonb(w.revision)
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id)->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
   AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
    WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1'
     AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(a.details,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
     AND a.details->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-async-owner/1'
     AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.request)
     AND a.details->>'envelope_sha256'=dr.envelope_sha256 AND a.details->'provider_timeout_ms'='240000'::jsonb)
 ), published AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS writer_work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,w.message_id
  FROM qualified w JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=w.message_id
   AND msg.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND msg.body=w.result->>'text'
  WHERE w.kind='narration' AND (
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=ub.source_window_id
     AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id=w.message_id
    WHERE ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.writer_work_id=w.id
     AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL AND ub.message_id=w.message_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
    JOIN public.mission_run_publications pub ON pub.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id AND pub.event_id=bs.event_id
    JOIN public.mission_run_outbox ob ON ob.publication_id=pub.id AND ob.master_session_id=p_session AND ob.event_id=bs.event_id
     AND ob.state='published' AND ob.published_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication
  FROM qualified w JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=w.id WHERE w.kind='narration'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
 ), settled AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM settled_raw s WHERE 1=(SELECT count(DISTINCT check_s.publication)
   FROM settled_raw check_s WHERE check_s.work_id=s.work_id AND check_s.request=s.request)
 ), items AS(
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',s.request),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication) AS item
  FROM settled s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication)
  FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  JOIN settled s ON s.request=pr.result->'dispatch'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=s.work_id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'=t.source_revision AND sw.consumed_message_id=(s.publication->>'message_id')::uuid
  WHERE t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=t.staff_user_id AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-journal-settlements/1','master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$
sources.journal_correction3/mission_generic_room:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where superseded_role.master_session_id=m.id
     and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(superseded_role.id)
     and (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id
     order by uf_round.round_no desc limit 2) uf_r),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_enc.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into uf_rounds from public.combat_v2_sessions uf_enc
 where uf_enc.master_session_id=m.id and uf_enc.closed_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches hidden_batch
   where hidden_batch.encounter_id=uf_enc.id and hidden_batch.source_window_id is not null
     and hidden_batch.composition_kind='entry_png' and hidden_batch.state in('preparing','ready')
     and hidden_batch.message_id is null);
 uf_marker:=mission_generic_owner.unified_progress_marker(m.id);
 if private_pending then uf_marker:=jsonb_set(uf_marker,'{batch}','null'::jsonb,false);end if;
 uf_review:=coalesce((uf_marker->>'review_required')::boolean,false);
 if academy and m.stato='in_corso' and r.run_phase='in_corso' then
  select rw.publication_id into flow_publication
  from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
  join public.combat_v2_rounds cr on cr.id=rw.round_id
  join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.id=cr.session_id
  where rw.master_session_id=m.id and rw.publication_id is not null
   and cs.closed_at is null and cs.state='in_corso'
  order by cr.round_no desc,rw.round_id desc limit 1;
  if flow_publication is not null then flow_state:='combat_started';
  else
   select ub.message_id into flow_publication
   from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
   where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.step_key=r.current_step_key
    and ub.run_control_version=r.control_version and ub.state='published'
    and ub.route is not null and ub.encounter_id is null
   order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
   if uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
     where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.state in('preparing','ready','needs_review')
       and not mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(ub.source_window_id))
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
     where sw.master_session_id=m.id and sw.consumed_message_id is null
      and (m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
        or not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id) or sw.superseded_at is null))
   then flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
   elsif flow_publication is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from public.messages role_msg
    where role_msg.location_id=m.location_id and role_msg.kind='say'
     and role_msg.recipient_user is null
     and role_msg.created_at>(select scene_msg.created_at from public.messages scene_msg where scene_msg.id=flow_publication)
     and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp
      join public.characters c on c.id=mp.character_id and c.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
      where mp.session_id=m.id and mp.character_id=role_msg.character_id
       and mp.joined_at<=role_msg.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>role_msg.created_at)))
   then flow_state:='new_scene';
   else flow_state:='waiting_roles';flow_publication:=null;end if;
  end if;
 end if;
 if private_pending then
  flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
  vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 IF academy AND mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id)
 
THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    WHERE c.master_session_id=m.id) THEN
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_flow_status_v1(m.id,uid);
  ELSE
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_status_snapshot_v1(m.id,uid,flow_state,uf_processing,uf_review);
  END IF;
  IF m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
    AND role_diag IS NOT NULL THEN
    role_diag:=role_diag||jsonb_build_object('flow_reason','review_required',
      'next_actor','staff','flow_detail',null);
  END IF;
END IF;
  -- C1266: new finite source opt-in, proved from server start/admission, not a client state heuristic.
  IF staff AND participant AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid THEN
   c26_proof:=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) THEN mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(m.id) ELSE mission_generic_owner.c1266_clean_staff_admission_v1(m.id,true,false) END;
  END IF;
  IF c26_proof IS NOT NULL THEN
   c26_revision:=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id);
   SELECT st.kind INTO c26_phase_kind FROM public.mission_plan_steps st
    WHERE st.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND st.step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
   c26_kind:='none';
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) AND role_diag IS NULL THEN c26_revision:=NULL;END IF;
   -- Native is the currently bound mechanical FSM with a published native entry/window.
   -- No work is required: this includes gathering PG declarations/defenses after a Fato.
   IF NOT private_pending AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters ee
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=ee.encounter_id AND cs.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.mission_plan_steps ps ON ps.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND ps.step_key=ee.step_key AND ps.kind='mechanical'
    JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds cr ON cr.session_id=cs.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw ON rw.round_id=cr.id AND rw.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.id=rw.batch_id AND ub.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.messages pubmsg ON pubmsg.id=rw.publication_id AND pubmsg.id=ub.message_id
     AND pubmsg.kind='fato' AND pubmsg.recipient_user IS NULL AND pubmsg.location_id=p_location
    WHERE ee.master_session_id=m.id AND ee.step_key=r.current_step_key AND ee.run_control_version=r.control_version
     AND cs.closed_at IS NULL AND cs.state NOT IN('chiuso','annullato') AND ub.state='published') THEN
    c26_kind:='native';
   ELSIF c26_phase_kind='narrative' AND active
    AND c26_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=c26_revision
    AND mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) THEN
    -- Includes legitimate ready_to_evaluate with no work: kind follows the narrative FSM, not absence of a job.
    c26_kind:='tick';
   END IF;
   -- A qualified manual scene without a role cursor keeps the existing
   -- read-only fallback revision. This does not grant a tick or create a cursor.

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where superseded_role.master_session_id=m.id
     and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(superseded_role.id)
     and (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id
     order by uf_round.round_no desc limit 2) uf_r),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_enc.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into uf_rounds from public.combat_v2_sessions uf_enc
 where uf_enc.master_session_id=m.id and uf_enc.closed_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches hidden_batch
   where hidden_batch.encounter_id=uf_enc.id and hidden_batch.source_window_id is not null
     and hidden_batch.composition_kind='entry_png' and hidden_batch.state in('preparing','ready')
     and hidden_batch.message_id is null);
 uf_marker:=mission_generic_owner.unified_progress_marker(m.id);
 if private_pending then uf_marker:=jsonb_set(uf_marker,'{batch}','null'::jsonb,false);end if;
 uf_review:=coalesce((uf_marker->>'review_required')::boolean,false);
 if academy and m.stato='in_corso' and r.run_phase='in_corso' then
  select rw.publication_id into flow_publication
  from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
  join public.combat_v2_rounds cr on cr.id=rw.round_id
  join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.id=cr.session_id
  where rw.master_session_id=m.id and rw.publication_id is not null
   and cs.closed_at is null and cs.state='in_corso'
  order by cr.round_no desc,rw.round_id desc limit 1;
  if flow_publication is not null then flow_state:='combat_started';
  else
   select ub.message_id into flow_publication
   from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
   where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.step_key=r.current_step_key
    and ub.run_control_version=r.control_version and ub.state='published'
    and ub.route is not null and ub.encounter_id is null
   order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
   if uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
     where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.state in('preparing','ready','needs_review')
       and not mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(ub.source_window_id))
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
     where sw.master_session_id=m.id and sw.consumed_message_id is null
      and (m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
        or not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id) or sw.superseded_at is null))
   then flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
   elsif flow_publication is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from public.messages role_msg
    where role_msg.location_id=m.location_id and role_msg.kind='say'
     and role_msg.recipient_user is null
     and role_msg.created_at>(select scene_msg.created_at from public.messages scene_msg where scene_msg.id=flow_publication)
     and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp
      join public.characters c on c.id=mp.character_id and c.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
      where mp.session_id=m.id and mp.character_id=role_msg.character_id
       and mp.joined_at<=role_msg.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>role_msg.created_at)))
   then flow_state:='new_scene';
   else flow_state:='waiting_roles';flow_publication:=null;end if;
  end if;
 end if;
 if private_pending then
  flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
  vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 IF academy AND mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id)
 
THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    WHERE c.master_session_id=m.id) THEN
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_flow_status_v1(m.id,uid);
  ELSE
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_status_snapshot_v1(m.id,uid,flow_state,uf_processing,uf_review);
  END IF;
  IF m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
    AND role_diag IS NOT NULL THEN
    role_diag:=role_diag||jsonb_build_object('flow_reason','review_required',
      'next_actor','staff','flow_detail',null);
  END IF;
END IF;
  -- C1266: new finite source opt-in, proved from server start/admission, not a client state heuristic.
  IF staff AND participant AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid THEN
   c26_proof:=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) THEN mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(m.id) ELSE mission_generic_owner.c1266_clean_staff_admission_v1(m.id,true,false) END;
  END IF;
  IF c26_proof IS NOT NULL THEN
   c26_revision:=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id);
   SELECT st.kind INTO c26_phase_kind FROM public.mission_plan_steps st
    WHERE st.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND st.step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
   c26_kind:='none';
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) AND role_diag IS NULL THEN c26_revision:=NULL;END IF;
   -- Native is the currently bound mechanical FSM with a published native entry/window.
   -- No work is required: this includes gathering PG declarations/defenses after a Fato.
   IF NOT private_pending AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters ee
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=ee.encounter_id AND cs.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.mission_plan_steps ps ON ps.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND ps.step_key=ee.step_key AND ps.kind='mechanical'
    JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds cr ON cr.session_id=cs.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw ON rw.round_id=cr.id AND rw.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.id=rw.batch_id AND ub.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.messages pubmsg ON pubmsg.id=rw.publication_id AND pubmsg.id=ub.message_id
     AND pubmsg.kind='fato' AND pubmsg.recipient_user IS NULL AND pubmsg.location_id=p_location
    WHERE ee.master_session_id=m.id AND ee.step_key=r.current_step_key AND ee.run_control_version=r.control_version
     AND cs.closed_at IS NULL AND cs.state NOT IN('chiuso','annullato') AND ub.state='published') THEN
    c26_kind:='native';
   ELSIF c26_phase_kind='narrative' AND active
    AND c26_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=c26_revision
    AND mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) THEN
    -- Includes legitimate ready_to_evaluate with no work: kind follows the narrative FSM, not absence of a job.
    c26_kind:='tick';
   END IF;
   -- A qualified manual scene without a role cursor keeps the existing
   -- read-only fallback revision. This does not grant a tick or create a cursor.
   IF c26_kind='none' AND c26_revision IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id)
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
    c26_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 -- C1264 AGG2: read-only receipt summary, confined to the existing protected scene.
 IF (m.id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid OR (c26_proof IS NOT NULL AND c26_kind='tick'))
  AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND staff AND participant
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) OR uid IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions f WHERE f.master_session_id=m.id AND f.enabled)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=p_location AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
  AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id) THEN
  st_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';st_state:='absent';
  SELECT * INTO st_tick FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
    WHERE t.master_session_id=m.id AND t.source_revision=st_revision;
  IF FOUND THEN
   st_original_key:=st_tick.request_key;st_owner:=coalesce(st_tick.actor_user_id=uid,false);st_state:='blocked';
   IF st_original_key IS NOT NULL AND st_tick.result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
      JOIN public.profiles tp ON tp.id=mp.user_id_snapshot AND tp.role IN('admin','master')
      WHERE mp.session_id=m.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=st_tick.actor_user_id AND mp.left_at IS NULL)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles sp WHERE sp.id=st_tick.staff_user_id AND sp.role IN('admin','master')) THEN
    SELECT * INTO st_receipt FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
     WHERE pr.request_key=st_original_key AND pr.master_session_id=m.id AND pr.actor_user_id=st_tick.actor_user_id
      AND pr.result_sha256=st_tick.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result);
    st_valid:=FOUND;
    WHILE st_valid LOOP
     st_dispatch:=st_receipt.result->'dispatch';
     IF st_receipt.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-progress/1'
      OR jsonb_typeof(st_dispatch) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR NOT(st_dispatch ?& ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','event_id','request_key','expected_revision'])
      OR st_dispatch-'schema_version'-'master_session_id'-'event_id'-'request_key'-'expected_revision'<>'{}'::jsonb
      OR st_dispatch->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-request/1'
      OR st_dispatch->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM m.id::text
      OR (st_dispatch->>'event_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR (st_dispatch->>'request_key' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR jsonb_typeof(st_dispatch->'expected_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
      OR (st_dispatch->>'expected_revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN st_blocked:=true;EXIT;END IF;
     IF (st_dispatch->>'expected_revision')::numeric>9223372036854775807 THEN st_blocked:=true;EXIT;END IF;
     SELECT w.id,w.master_session_id,w.event_id,w.request_key,w.revision,w.kind,w.state,w.authority_receipt_id,w.finalized_at,w.created_at,w.lease_expires_at,w.step_key,w.run_control_version,w.definition_sha256 INTO st_work
      FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w WHERE w.event_id=(st_dispatch->>'event_id')::uuid
       AND w.master_session_id=m.id AND w.request_key=(st_dispatch->>'request_key')::uuid AND w.revision=(st_dispatch->>'expected_revision')::bigint;
     IF NOT FOUND THEN st_blocked:=true;EXIT;END IF;
     -- ACK belongs only to this effective validated successor, never to a computed next key.
     st_ack_predecessor:=st_candidate_predecessor;
     st_effective_id:=st_work.id;st_public_state:=CASE WHEN st_work.state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started') AND st_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() THEN 'uncertain' ELSE st_work.state END;
     st_state:='attested';st_released:=false;st_next_key:=NULL;st_recovery:=NULL;
     IF st_work.kind='director' AND st_work.id=(st_dispatch->>'event_id')::uuid AND st_work.state='failed' AND st_work.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT sw.id,sw.master_session_id,sw.work_id,sw.superseded_reason,sw.consumed_message_id,sw.context->>'source_revision' AS source_revision,sw.step_key,sw.run_control_version,sw.definition_sha256 INTO st_source
       FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw WHERE sw.id=st_work.authority_receipt_id AND sw.work_id=st_work.id AND sw.master_session_id=m.id;
      IF FOUND AND st_source.source_revision=st_revision AND st_source.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
       AND st_source.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(st_source.id) THEN
       st_released:=true;st_state:='released';st_recovery:=st_work.id;
       IF st_depth=0 THEN st_next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(st_work.id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||st_revision);
       ELSIF st_depth=1 THEN st_next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(st_work.id,'mission-staff-db-context-retry/2:'||st_revision);END IF;
      END IF;
     END IF;
     IF st_next_key IS NULL THEN EXIT;END IF;
     SELECT * INTO st_receipt FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr WHERE pr.request_key=st_next_key;
     IF NOT FOUND THEN EXIT;END IF;
     IF st_receipt.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.id OR st_receipt.actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM st_tick.actor_user_id

# Aggregata 4 — matrice di composizione

Stato: candidata sorgente, nessuna installazione né chiamata provider. Questa matrice traccia i consumer; non costituisce collaudo eseguito.

| Caso | Producer e consumer | Evidenza statica | Prova Staff residua |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recupero fallimento zero-provider già rilasciato | role_source_released_v4 installato → room_state/tick | Solo motivo nuovo del work/scena nominativi e helper autorevole; precedente storico immutato | Ricevuta released dal sito |
| Ammissione manuale senza rinnovo campagne | room_state → can_resume | Nuovo ramo limitato a manual admission/3 della stessa scena/binding/Root; gate runtime/budget, owner e assenza altri lavori conservati | owned_by_me=true, can_resume=true per attore titolare |
| Journal originale non blocca il successore | journal_settlements/2 → settleAsyncRecords/restoreJournals | Release è DTO distinto dalla publication, legato a parent exactnamed/audit; journal originale intatto, solo osservatore inattivo | Refresh mostra assenza avviso storico |
| Invio unico della ripresa | tick-status/2 → invokeAsyncOnce journal/6 | Namespace deterministico source_revision+released_work_id; original journal clonato dentro recovery e conservato alla chiave iniziale; POST ammesso soltanto da nuova proiezione autorevole released/owned/can_resume | Un successor, nessun reinvio delle due role |
| Retry idempotente server | staff_tick → progress_step/unified_enqueue_director | Nuovo motivo nominativo entra nel medesimo retry request_key deterministico; receipt progress originale conservata, replay restituisce stesso successor | Seconda lettura restituisce stessa ricevuta, senza nuovo provider |
| Director → Writer | normali consumer già installati | Nessun cambio a decisione, meccanica, barriera o catena di pubblicazione; nuovo contratto emesso dal Root corrente | Una Count+Generation per ciascuno, entro budget autorizzato |
| Reload durante invio incerto | journal/6 → async-recover → dispatch_async_status | Lettore segue soltanto retry receipt già esistente, stesso nuovo motivo + helper; assenza receipt non crea lavoro e non concede retry/provider | Recupero readonly della stessa richiesta |
| Pubblicazione singola | normali batch/Fato → settlement published | Nessuna modifica a pubblicatore; receipt originale richiede hash originale del tick; retry deterministico richiede parent originale attestato/rilasciato e hash proprio canonico del successor, con sessione/attore/fonte/dispatch esatti | Un nuovo Fato; tre Fati precedenti invariati |
| Reload dopo pubblicazione / turno seguente | journal_settlements/2 → original/recovery journals | Release storica sempre distinta dalla publication successor; matching per work_id, recovery esclude parent; famiglia schema2 consente stesso tick selector per due work diversi | Nessun ritorno del blocco storico dopo uscita/rientro |
| Utente Staff diverso / fonte diversa / prova diversa | owner projection, scope server e validatori UI | Nuova release limitata alla scena/work indicati; localStorage non concede autorità, mayCreateStaffTick richiede owner/can_resume | Nessun invio per account non titolare; lettura del Fato collettivo |

## Compatibilità e recovery

- DTO Edge, tick-status/2 e chiamate HTTP invariati. Non occorre deploy Edge89.
- Journal /1–/5 e publication settlement/1 restano leggibili. /6 è solo journal di ripresa Staff nominativa; schema settlement/2 distingue la chiusura senza pubblicazione.
- Le firme e le ACL delle quattro funzioni esistenti restano invariate. Nessun nuovo grant o client access all'helper.
- Occorre un'unica composizione di quattro corpi DB, client UI, Root/header e metadati. I client vecchi falliscono chiusi davanti a schema2, quindi reload verificato della versione UI è necessario prima del turno.
- Nessun reset di localStorage, contatori, receipt o source; nessuna cancellazione. Dopo source release si prosegue in avanti sul successor, senza riaprire terminali.
- La finestra provider precedente è scaduta a consumi zero. La candidata non avvia provider; il turno richiede la nuova finestra operativa prima dell'invio.

La UI resta identica alla candidata aggregata3, versione esplicita `mission-academy-flow-v4-staff-client/1-c1266-request-recovery3`: aggregata4 modifica soltanto il binding readonly delle due ricevute progress distinte nel settlement della pubblicazione.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')

 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(p_session uuid, p_failed_director uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
declare
  m public.master_v2_sessions;
  run public.mission_run_state;
  work mission_generic_owner.work_items;
  window_row mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;
  receipt mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;

  budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;
  budget_pol mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy;
  budget_spent numeric;budget_http bigint;budget_bound numeric;budget_cap_cost numeric;budget_cap_http integer;budget_ok boolean;

  fixed_release jsonb;
  fix jsonb;
begin
  -- Named, zero-provider recovery. Preserve the terminal work and receipt.
  -- Release only the unconsumed source; the normal service enqueuer will
  -- capture the same latest roles and issue a fresh current-Root contract.
  IF p_session=''44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac''::uuid
    AND p_failed_director=''d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e''::uuid THEN
    m:=mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_regen_scope(p_session,auth.uid());
    PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_CURSOR_MISSING'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'';END IF;
    PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
    SELECT * INTO STRICT run FROM public.mission_run_state
      WHERE master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items

      WHERE id=work.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=work.id
        AND master_session_id=p_session FOR UPDATE;
    IF window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL
      AND window_row.superseded_reason=''staff_preprovider_request_retry''
      AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-staff-director-retry/1'',
        ''status'',''released'',''replayed'',true);
    END IF;
    IF run.run_phase IS DISTINCT FROM ''in_corso'' OR m.closed_at IS NOT NULL
      OR work.kind IS DISTINCT FROM ''director'' OR work.state IS DISTINCT FROM ''failed''
      OR work.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM ''d9bcfa25361578bc3213b754c30076336d108c9f3a516360a534416c40686038''
      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM ''71dcd5af8c1022ae8d546719f739065462dc3f51715a3e4ac700e8da9b43dc91''

      OR work.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(work.result)

      OR work.result->>''failure_code'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''request_validation_failed''
      OR work.result->''provider_calls'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''0''::jsonb
      OR work.result->''charged_cost_usd'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''0''::jsonb
      OR work.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR work.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
      OR work.receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM ''d1143e1a-f74e-47a1-9cef-44cd5dfda65b''::uuid
      OR work.dispatch_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM ''a1111f12-52c1-4628-b015-a76bfb6ac552''::uuid
      OR work.finalized_at IS NULL OR work.message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR window_row.superseded_at IS NOT NULL OR window_row.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
      OR window_row.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM run.current_step_key
      OR window_row.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM run.control_version
      OR window_row.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.definition_sha256
      OR window_row.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM work.payload_sha256
      OR window_row.context->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''0f3feca5bc4e0c839f26cc43b8ddebf8e372ebdbfaab3ec88cb64e5eff436cef''
      OR window_row.context->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session)
      OR window_row.role_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[''cb3e0cb1-b046-4462-84df-7916056fedc6''::uuid,''0df4a6cd-c396-4bf2-ba0a-05184d9a20b5''::uuid]
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(window_row.role_ids) role_id
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
          WHERE lr.message_id=role_id AND lr.valid))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.source_window_id=window_row.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items newer
        WHERE newer.master_session_id=p_session AND newer.created_at>work.created_at)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items active
        WHERE active.master_session_id=p_session AND active.state NOT IN(''completed'',''failed''))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions cs WHERE cs.master_session_id=p_session AND cs.closed_at IS NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_SOURCE_CHANGED'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts
      WHERE id=work.dispatch_receipt_id FOR SHARE;
    IF receipt.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_session
      OR receipt.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM work.id
      OR receipt.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM work.request_key
      OR receipt.status IS DISTINCT FROM ''failed'' OR receipt.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR receipt.upper_bound_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0
      OR receipt.finalized_at IS NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code LIKE ''c8_count_%'')
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.source_id=receipt.id)
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
        WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code=''generic_pre_provider_failed''
          AND a.details->>''work_id''=work.id::text
          AND a.details->>''receipt_id''=work.receipt_id::text
          AND a.details->>''failure_code''=''request_validation_failed''
          AND a.details->>''result_sha256''=work.result_sha256
          AND a.details->''provider_calls''=''0''::jsonb
          AND a.details->''charged_cost_usd''=''0''::jsonb)<>1
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 wc
        WHERE wc.work_id=work.id AND wc.master_session_id=p_session
          AND wc.contract_sha256=''2efea76854b67c641e0d5a340afcc55e5e87115129bf449a66858368afc34406''
          AND wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
          AND wc.release_sha256=''a446f0113dd39f6ab6b4c9b5a625006bb4d6a1cfd2295488e338f7357e9c0a2c'')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_ZERO_PROVIDER_ATTESTATION'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'';END IF;
    SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb INTO fixed_release
      FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
      JOIN mission_factory_owner.c464_control cc ON cc.singleton
      WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.scope=''staff'' AND rr.state=''enabled''
        AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256
        AND rr.revision_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'')
        AND rr.staff_guards_verified AND rr.published_assets_verified
        AND cc.complete AND cc.runtime_enabled AND NOT cc.authoring_enabled
        AND cc.expires_at>statement_timestamp() AND cc.release_sha256=rr.revision_sha256
        AND cc.review_sha256=rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>''{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}''
      FOR SHARE OF rr,cc;
    fix:=fixed_release#>''{config,c1266_request_size_fix}'';
    IF fix->>''schema_version'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''c1266-request-size-fix/1''
      OR fix->>''scene_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM p_session::text
      OR fix->>''failed_work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM work.id::text
      OR fix->>''payload_sha256'' IS DISTINCT FROM work.payload_sha256
      OR fix->>''result_sha256'' IS DISTINCT FROM work.result_sha256
      OR fix->>''retry_source_md5'' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT md5(p.prosrc) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=''public.mission_staff_retry_failed_director_v1(uuid,uuid)''::regprocedure)
      OR fix->>''release_source_md5'' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT md5(p.prosrc) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=''mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(uuid)''::regprocedure)
      OR fix->>''review_sha256'' IS DISTINCT FROM fixed_release#>>''{config,staff_finite_ia_budget,composed_review_sha256}''
      OR (fix->>''review_sha256''~''^[a-f0-9]{64}$'') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(fixed_release->''edge_bundles'') eb
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(eb->''files'') ef
        WHERE eb->>''name''=''mission_generic_ai'' AND eb->>''version''=''89''
          AND eb->>''ezbr_sha256''=fix->>''edge_bundle_sha256''
          AND ef->>''name''=''mission-generic-runtime.mjs'' AND ef->>''sha256''=fix->>''runtime_module_sha256'')
      OR mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
      OR mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_FIXED_COMPOSITION_REQUIRED'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'';END IF;
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
      SET superseded_at=clock_timestamp(),superseded_reason=''staff_preprovider_request_retry''
      WHERE id=window_row.id AND superseded_at IS NULL AND consumed_message_id IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_SOURCE_CAS'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
    INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)
      VALUES(receipt.id,''staff_preprovider_request_retry'',jsonb_build_object(
        ''schema_version'',''c1266-request-size-release/1'',''master_session_id'',p_session,
        ''work_id'',work.id,''source_window_id'',window_row.id,''payload_sha256'',work.payload_sha256,
        ''result_sha256'',work.result_sha256,''role_ids_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(window_row.role_ids)),
        ''source_revision'',window_row.context->>''source_revision'',
        ''fixed_release_sha256'',(SELECT revision_sha256 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton),
        ''fixed_review_sha256'',fix->>''review_sha256'',''fixed_runtime_sha256'',fix->>''runtime_module_sha256'',
        ''fixed_bundle_sha256'',fix->>''edge_bundle_sha256'',
        ''provider_calls'',0,''charged_cost_usd'',0,''historical_work_preserved'',true));
    IF NOT mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(window_row.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION ''REQUEST_RETRY_RELEASE_NOT_ATTESTED'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'';END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-staff-director-retry/1'',
      ''status'',''released'',''replayed'',false);
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO work FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_failed_director AND master_session_id=p_session;
  IF FOUND AND work.result->>''schema_version''=''mission-count-overflow-failure/1'' THEN
    IF auth.uid() NOT IN(''f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665''::uuid,''b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b''::uuid)
      OR auth.uid() IS NULL OR p_session<>''ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9''::uuid
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.role IN(''admin'',''master''))
      OR combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(''0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b''::uuid,array[auth.uid()],false) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
